## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive. Market shows mixed signals: strong short‑week winners (INTC, QCOM, GOOGL) offset by 1W weakness in marquee names (NVDA, META), and leadership concentrated in Technology (Leadership: Concentrated — 3/5 Tech in Top 5).

2. Which sectors are leading?
Energy lead: MPC (1W: +9.82% | 1M: +3.35%) ABOVE TREND, PSX (1W: +8.19% | 1M: +0.31%) ABOVE TREND; Energy breadth: 8/10 positive. Consumer Staples: MO (1W: +11.47% | 1M: +13.85%) ABOVE TREND; Staples breadth: 11/14 positive. Technology: INTC (1W: +20.69% | 1M: +107.41%) ABOVE TREND, QCOM (1W: +18.92% | 1M: +39.07%) ABOVE TREND, GOOGL (1W: +11.99% | 1M: +29.69%) ABOVE TREND; Technology breadth: 15/24 positive.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Materials lagging: FCX (1W: -7.37% | 1M: -7.39%) BELOW TREND, NEM (1W: -10.01% | 1M: -4.54%) BELOW TREND; Materials breadth: 3/11 positive. Consumer Discretionary: BKNG (1W: -5.89% | 1M: +1.34%) CORRECTION, SBUX (1W: +7.33% | 1M: +17.11%) ABOVE TREND — mixed internals; Consumer Disc breadth: 5/14 positive. Healthcare weak: SYK (1W: -10.01% | 1M: -10.53%) BELOW TREND, ISRG (1W: -5.07% | 1M: -1.44%) BELOW TREND; Healthcare breadth: 6/17 positive.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: INTC (1W: +20.69% | 1M: +107.41%) ABOVE TREND; QCOM (1W: +18.92% | 1M: +39.07%) ABOVE TREND; GOOGL (1W: +11.99% | 1M: +29.69%) ABOVE TREND; MO (1W: +11.47% | 1M: +13.85%) ABOVE TREND; GD (1W: +10.42% | 1M: -0.88%) RECOVERY. Leadership: Concentrated (3/5 Technology).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: NVDA (1W: -4.72% | 1M: +12.92%) CORRECTION; ISRG (1W: -5.07% | 1M: -1.44%) BELOW TREND; VST (1W: -5.52% | 1M: +0.86%) CORRECTION; SHW (1W: -5.83% | 1M: -2.36%) BELOW TREND; BKNG (1W: -5.89% | 1M: +1.34%) CORRECTION. Weakness concentrated in Materials and select Healthcare/Tech names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W: INTC (1W: +20.69% | 1M: +107.41%) ABOVE TREND; QCOM (1W: +18.92% | 1M: +39.07%) ABOVE TREND; GOOGL (1W: +11.99% | 1M: +29.69%) ABOVE TREND; MO (1W: +11.47% | 1M: +13.85%) ABOVE TREND. Major divergence present — multiple marquee names (NVDA, MSFT, META, AMAT) show 1W ↓ vs 1M ↑ → MAJOR Divergence; watch for trend break and avoid strong regime bets.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed and selective. AAPL (1W: +3.35% | 1M: +9.59%) ABOVE TREND and INTC/QCOM/GOOGL ABOVE TREND show rotation inside Tech, while NVDA (1W: -4.72% | 1M: +12.92%) CORRECTION, MSFT (1W: -2.40% | 1M: +12.20%) CORRECTION and META (1W: -9.82% | 1M: +5.10%) CORRECTION highlight near‑term exhaustion; Technology breadth: 15/24 positive.

8. Financials Outlook?
Cautiously constructive. JPM (1W: +1.36% | 1M: +6.33%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: +6.01% | 1M: +9.89%) ABOVE TREND support stable financial internals, while MA (1W: -1.73% | 1M: +0.95%) CORRECTION flags some dispersion; Financials breadth: 13/20 positive.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Selective weakness with pockets of strength. UNH (1W: +3.91% | 1M: +34.60%) ABOVE TREND and LLY (1W: +8.98% | 1M: +0.92%) ABOVE TREND contrast with SYK (1W: -10.01% | 1M: -10.53%) BELOW TREND and ISRG (1W: -5.07% | 1M: -1.44%) BELOW TREND; Healthcare breadth: 6/17 positive.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Maintain neutral positioning and favor selective exposure to Energy and a subset of Tech winners (INTC, QCOM, GOOGL) while reducing exposure to lagging Materials and beaten Healthcare (SHW, SYK). Style: mixed / no clear leadership — monitor MAJOR Divergence before shifting beta.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: INTC (1W: +20.69% | 1M: +107.41%) ABOVE TREND, GOOGL (1W: +11.99% | 1M: +29.69%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +9.82% | 1M: +3.35%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: NVDA (1W: -4.72% | 1M: +12.92%) CORRECTION, META (1W: -9.82% | 1M: +5.10%) CORRECTION, SYK (1W: -10.01% | 1M: -10.53%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Energy (Breadth: 8/10 positive) and Technology selective (Breadth: 15/24 positive) for continuation. BEARISH: Materials (Breadth: 3/11 positive) and parts of Healthcare (Breadth: 6/17 positive) on earnings/sentiment risk.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch NVDA for failure to reclaim its recent 1M uptrend (continued 1W weakness would signal further CORRECTION). Monitor INTC/QCOM for follow‑through above this week’s breakout range to confirm ABOVE TREND continuation. Use UNH strength as a proxy for defensive healthcare leadership holding; treat large 1W reversals in major tech as tactical triggers.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
GD (+80): Q1 guide raise; GD (1W: +10.42% | 1M: -0.88%) RECOVERY — news confirmed by strong 1W. UNH (+60): Q1 beat; UNH (1W: +3.91% | 1M: +34.60%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed. MPC (+60): upgrades/dividend; MPC (1W: +9.82% | 1M: +3.35%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
SHW (-55): weak end‑market comment; SHW (1W: -5.83% | 1M: -2.36%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed. SYK (-45): Q1 miss & disruption; SYK (1W: -10.01% | 1M: -10.53%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed. (Limited SP100 matches in bearish list; monitor other flagged names for spillover.)

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership. GOOGL (1W: +11.99% | 1M: +29.69%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +20.69% | 1M: +107.41%) ABOVE TREND and MPC (1W: +9.82% | 1M: +3.35%) ABOVE TREND showing relative strength. Key risk: MAJOR Divergence among mega‑caps (NVDA/MSFT/META showing 1W weakness vs 1M strength) and sentiment mismatches (SHW, SYK) — watch for trend confirmation before reallocating.
